correctness.rationale: Writing R(z)=u+cz, the Rota–Baxter equation with (z,v) forces u=0 by the nondegenerate alternating bracket; R^2(z)=0 then c=0. For v in the horizontal symplectic space, equations reduce exactly to U=im A totally isotropic, U subset ker A, and phi(U)=0. For rank r<=n choose isotropic U in I_{n,r} ways, surjection V/U onto U in S_{n,r} ways, phi in q^{2n-r} ways. The full rank increases from r to r+1 exactly when phi|ker A is nonzero; q^r functionals do not increase it. Independent calculation gives n=2,q=2 polynomial 1+225t+990t² and exhaustive 3-dimensional F2 original RB and square-zero equations gives 1+9t. Dominant horizontal stratum has degree 2n+r(8n-5r-1)/2 and successive degree difference 4n+2-5r; tie iff n≡2 mod5. No division by 2: all characteristics included.
